Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) have demonstrated significant capabilities across a spectrum of audio understanding and in-context learning tasks. These include instruction following, emotion recognition (ER), gender recognition (GR), speech question answering (SQA), and audio question answering (AQA).
outputs: The generated outputs include responses to audio and text prompts in tasks such as audio question answering, emotion judgment, and context-based reasoning, where models generate natural language answers based on multimodal input.
